steps.title: Run the Kinglet example
steps.description:
Create an empty .blyx file, insert blyx-kinglet-demo and choose **Blyx: Run File**.
[Open the documentation](https://www.blyx-lang.space/packages/kinglet)

steps.title: Read a checkpoint slice
steps.description:
Extract the starter. With the documented compiler revision installed, run the scale example task.
[Open the experiment](https://www.blyx-lang.space/articles/training-in-factors)
